main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
header_desc: By intertwining first-century spirituality with twenty-first-century physics, this work addresses the primordial question about our place in the universe. The solution to quantum gravity is revealed in two-thousand-year-old texts: the Gnostic gospels.
left_title: The Return to the ONE ✝️: Free Yourself from the Demiurge, the ego has mass ┻
left_body: If the ego curves space-time, matter emerges from the psyche, and the timelessness of the cosmos responds to the pneuma, reality is revealed as an act of perception. Consciousness oscillates between states lvert ONE ⟩ and lvert EGO ⟩, granting us a fundamental free will formalized in the inner product ⟨ ONE | EGO ⟩. The premise that the Father and I are one becomes a profound invitation to shed the false self and return to the pure light of the Ineffable Father.
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a larger-than-normal white man with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly there is such a God. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it makes no sense to pray to the law of gravity.
universe_light_text: The revelation that the Father is the universe and that death does not exist frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere lies the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Greater Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom is inside and outside of you Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): the timeless light of divine feeling in the right hemisphere versus the temporal density of material thought in the left hemisphere shows the duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. Gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: Breaking the chains of illusion is the first step to remembering where we come from. I invite you to invert the map of reality to begin seeing the world with different eyes.
